latest_release.name: Rakazo v0.8.0
latest_release.body:
### Added

- On iPhone and iPad, an image pasted into a chat's message field is added as an attachment, as on web. Text copied with it still goes into the field. This needs the new app build.
- On iPhone and iPad, Rakazo appears in the share sheet. Share a link, text, photos or files from any app, pick a bot, and it lands in that bot's message field as a draft. This needs the new app build.
- More keyboard shortcuts on web and desktop: start a group chat, connect apps, open the chat's details panel, jump to the message box and dictate. Cmd/Ctrl+/ lists every shortcut, as do **Keyboard shortcuts** in the command menu and **Help** in the desktop app.
- Cmd/Ctrl+F in the desktop app finds text in the open chat, highlighting every match and stepping through them. Searching bots moves to Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+F.
- The web app is fully translated into Turkish. Before, large parts of it fell back to English.
- When the desktop app runs its own local server, **Settings** now shows the **Let bots use this computer** switch, as it does when connected to another server.
- Self-hosters can make DeepSeek the deployment's default model with `PI_DEFAULT_PROVIDER=deepseek` and `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` ([self-hosted models](docs/self-host-models.md)).
- The long-wait "still needs an answer" reminder, and the notice that a waiting chat was stopped, now show as browser and desktop alerts, not only on phones.

### Changed

- A group message that names no bot now reaches every bot in the group, instead of only the first ([groups](docs/groups.md)). Each bot decides whether the message is for it, and a bot with nothing to add stays quiet. Replying to a bot's message or tagging a bot still sends to that bot alone. An untagged message can now start a run for each bot in the group, up to ten.

### Fixed

- Pressing Stop ends a quiet model call or a long-running tool within about a second. Before, it could keep running, and billing, for up to a minute.
- Connector and category approval rules now apply to tools named with a hyphen, like `<app>-<action>`, and loading a connected app's tool description no longer asks for approval.
- Switching to another chat on web no longer deletes attachments you picked but hadn't sent, and archiving a chat keeps them for when it's restored.
- Renaming a model connection no longer resets unsaved edits in the same form.
- Voice calls that use provider transcription now send a server's configured extra headers, so servers behind a gateway that needs them can transcribe calls.
- On Linux, a brief network drop while checking a downloaded desktop update no longer shows an update error. The update is kept and verified on the next check.
- On self-hosted Docker setups, a computer still running an older image no longer asks for payment approval on every browser click.



## What's Changed
* test: base negative Postgres assertions on settled work, not sleeps by @zicochaos in https://github.com/elie222/rakazo/pull/3345
* Alert open apps when a waiting chat is reminded or stopped by @elie222 in https://github.com/elie222/rakazo/pull/3350
* fix(web): keep unsaved model connection fields when renaming by @zicochaos in https://github.com/elie222/rakazo/pull/3352
* feat(groups): a message that names nobody reaches every member by @ald3b in https://github.com/elie222/rakazo/pull/2924
* fix(mobile): send server headers on the call transcription request by @zicochaos in https://github.com/elie222/rakazo/pull/3356
* fix(supervisor): pass on the page browser's refusal of an unknown command by @jfr956 in https://github.com/elie222/rakazo/pull/3358
* fix(web): keep unsent attachments when switching chats by @zicochaos in https://github.com/elie222/rakazo/pull/3364
* fix: apply connector rules to hyphenated tool names by @hphproton in https://github.com/elie222/rakazo/pull/3368
* Stop a quiet model call or tool within a second of pressing Stop by @rjdotdev in https://github.com/elie222/rakazo/pull/3369
* Repair and retry unreadable JSON verdicts from Auto

# Rakazo [English](./README.md) | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [日本語](./README.ja.md) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/elie222/rakazo?labelColor=black&style=for-the-badge&color=2563EB)](https://github.com/elie222/rakazo/stargazers) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20the%20community-5865F2?labelColor=black&style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/RWwKa2Sn7h) [![Download on the App Store](https://img.shields.io/badge/App%20Store-Download%20for%20iPhone-black?labelColor=black&style=for-the-badge&logo=apple&logoColor=white)](https://apps.apple.com/app/rakazo/id6801531099) [![Get Android on Google Play](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Play-Get%20the%20app-black?labelColor=black&style=for-the-badge&logo=googleplay&logoColor=white)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rakazo.app) ![Rakazo — AI teammates you actually own](./docs/readme-hero.png) Rakazo is an open source, self-hosted alternative to Grok Bot. Persistent AI teammates with their own memory, routines, apps, and computer. Run it on your own machine, with your own model. Use it on the [web](https://app.rakazo.com), [desktop](https://rakazo.com/download/), [iPhone](https://apps.apple.com/app/rakazo/id6801531099), and [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rakazo.app). It is also an alternative to Meta Muse, OpenAI Dots, Instinct, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and Claude Duet. Learn more at [rakazo.com](https://rakazo.com). ## Features - Routines - Memory - Computer and browser use - Private or shared team computers - Sandboxes in Docker, the cloud, or on your own machine - Group chats - Delegation and subagents - Builds dashboards and docs you can share by link - Voice chat and calls - Any model, with your own keys - Thousands of app integrations, plus MCP
### Every bot gets a computer A browser, terminal, files, and a full desktop. Watch it work, take control to sign in, and hand it back. ### Bots that work together Put bots in a group and @mention them. They split the work, check each other, and report back.
### Routines Run a bot on a schedule, from an email, or from a webhook, and see every run. ### Pages Bots build live dashboards and documents you can open full screen, share, and ask about.
